recipe_name: Ultralytics YOLO object detection fine-tuning balanced
task_specific_params: batch=-1 can be used for auto batch sizing; time can override epochs; tune if target metric is not met. Applies to Ultralytics YOLO detection families listed in model_families.
notes: Defaults and limited ranges are filled from Ultralytics train/config/tuning docs and model-page training examples. Dataset-specific ranges are intentionally left empty.

task_specific_params: ema_decay=0.9999; ema_warmups=2000; betas=[0.9,0.999]; clip_max_norm=0.1; backbone_lr=0.00001; freeze_bn=true; num_queries=300; decoder_layers=6; denoising_number=200; label_noise_ratio=0.5; box_noise_scale=1.0; augmentations=random color distort|expand|crop|flip|resize; Objects365 pretrain=12 epochs; R50/R101 COCO fine-tune=24 epochs; R18 COCO fine-tune=60 epochs.
notes: Recipe captures paper and official config defaults for RT-DETR fine-tuning. The official config reports EMA warmups as steps rather than epochs, so that value is kept in task_specific_params. The paper reports four V100 GPUs with global batch size 16; adjust per-device batch/accumulation for local hardware.

recipe_name: Torchvision RetinaNet ResNet-50-FPN COCO training with pretrained backbone
task_specific_params: trainable_backbone_layers=3; lr_steps=16|22; lr_gamma=0.1; aspect_ratio_group_factor=3; data_augmentation=hflip; batch_size=2 images per GPU; world_size=8; weights_backbone=ResNet50_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1; focal_loss_gamma=2; focal_loss_alpha=0.25; foreground_prior=0.01; topk_candidates_per_level=1000.
notes: Torchvision reference command trains RetinaNet ResNet-50-FPN on COCO for 26 epochs with LR 0.01 and an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 backbone on 8 GPUs. This is evidence for training with a pretrained backbone, not direct fine-tuning from pretrained RetinaNet detector weights on a custom dataset; focal-loss settings are from the RetinaNet paper.

recipe_name: Detectron2 RetinaNet R50-FPN COCO-pretrained custom fine-tuning
task_specific_params: MODEL.WEIGHTS=<Detectron2 model zoo RetinaNet R50-FPN COCO checkpoint>; MODEL.RETINANET.NUM_CLASSES=<custom_num_classes>; SOLVER.IMS_PER_BATCH=16; SOLVER.BASE_LR=0.01; SOLVER.STEPS=210000|250000 for 3x or 60000|80000 for 1x; SOLVER.MAX_ITER=270000 for 3x or 90000 for 1x; INPUT.MIN_SIZE_TRAIN=640|672|704|736|768|800; DATASETS.TRAIN=<custom_train>; DATASETS.TEST=<custom_val>; TEST.DETECTIONS_PER_IMAGE adjust if images contain more than 100 objects.
notes: Recommended Detectron2 pattern: register the custom dataset, start from a model-zoo RetinaNet R50-FPN COCO checkpoint, set RetinaNet class count, and scale batch size/LR when using fewer GPUs. Detectron2 RetinaNet schedules are iteration-based, so MAX_ITER/STEPS stay in task_specific_params instead of epoch columns. Hyperparameters come from Base-RetinaNet and R50 3x configs; fine-tuning-specific config edits come from Detectron2 custom dataset docs.

recipe_name: Torchvision Faster R-CNN ResNet-50-FPN COCO-pretrained custom fine-tuning
task_specific_params: weights=FasterRCNN_ResNet50_FPN_Weights.DEFAULT; replace roi_heads.box_predictor with FastRCNNPredictor(in_features, num_classes); batch_size=2 images per GPU in reference script; world_size=8; lr_steps=16|22; lr_gamma=0.1; aspect_ratio_group_factor=3; weights_backbone=ResNet50_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1; scale lr as 0.02/8*NGPU when changing GPU count.
notes: Official Torchvision fine-tuning pattern starts from COCO-pretrained Faster R-CNN and replaces the box predictor for custom classes. Scalar optimizer and schedule defaults come from the official Faster/Mask R-CNN detection reference recipe, not from the Mask R-CNN tutorial loop; validate epoch count and LR on the target dataset.

recipe_name: Detectron2 Faster R-CNN R50-FPN COCO-pretrained custom fine-tuning
task_specific_params: MODEL.WEIGHTS=<Detectron2 model zoo Faster R-CNN R50-FPN COCO checkpoint>; MODEL.ROI_HEADS.NUM_CLASSES=<custom_num_classes>; SOLVER.IMS_PER_BATCH=16; SOLVER.BASE_LR=0.02; SOLVER.STEPS=210000|250000 for 3x or 60000|80000 for 1x; SOLVER.MAX_ITER=270000 for 3x or 90000 for 1x; INPUT.MIN_SIZE_TRAIN=640|672|704|736|768|800; RPN.PRE_NMS_TOPK_TRAIN=2000; RPN.PRE_NMS_TOPK_TEST=1000; RPN.POST_NMS_TOPK_TRAIN=1000; RPN.POST_NMS_TOPK_TEST=1000; DATASETS.TRAIN=<custom_train>; DATASETS.TEST=<custom_val>; TEST.DETECTIONS_PER_IMAGE adjust if images contain more than 100 objects.
notes: Recommended Detectron2 pattern: register the custom dataset, start from a model-zoo Faster R-CNN R50-FPN COCO checkpoint, set ROI_HEADS class count, and scale batch size/LR when using fewer GPUs. Detectron2 Faster R-CNN schedules are iteration-based, so MAX_ITER/STEPS stay in task_specific_params instead of epoch columns.

recipe_name: Torchvision SSD300 VGG16 custom training with pretrained backbone
task_specific_params: weights_backbone=VGG16_Weights.IMAGENET1K_FEATURES; num_classes=<custom_num_classes>; trainable_backbone_layers=4; batch_size=4 images per GPU; world_size=8; lr_steps=80|110; lr_gamma=0.1; aspect_ratio_group_factor=3; data_augmentation=ssd; transforms=RandomPhotometricDistort|RandomZoomOut|RandomIoUCrop|RandomHorizontalFlip; fixed_size=300x300; detections_per_img=200; topk_candidates=400; positive_fraction=0.25.
notes: Official Torchvision SSD300 reference trains on COCO with an ImageNet-pretrained VGG16 feature backbone. For custom class counts, this is the directly supported initialization path; COCO detector weights use the COCO class set, so custom-class fine-tuning from detector weights requires careful head replacement/partial loading outside the documented reference recipe.
